title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via Aspley, Caboolture and Petrie (QLD)
current_summary: The planned fibre cable migration affecting nbn services connected through the Aspley, Caboolture and Petrie areas in Queensland is complete. The work finished at 6:00 am AEST on Friday 6 November 2026. Some services may have been interrupted for up to 6 hours during the maintenance window.

cause.reason: Planned fibre cable migration being carried out by an upstream network provider.

updates.content: Our upstream network provider has advised us of planned fibre cable migration work. It may affect nbn services connected through the Aspley, Caboolture and Petrie areas in Queensland. The maintenance window is between 12:00 am and 6:00 am AEST on Friday 6 November 2026. During this window, affected services may be interrupted for up to 6 hours. We will share any further updates as we receive them.

The planned fibre cable migration started at 12:00 am AEST on Friday 6 November 2026. Some nbn services connected through the Aspley, Caboolture and Petrie areas may be interrupted for up to 6 hours while the work is carried out. The window is scheduled to end at 6:00 am AEST, and we will share further updates as we receive them.

The planned fibre cable migration has been completed as of 6:00 am AEST on Friday 6 November 2026. nbn services connected through the Aspley, Caboolture and Petrie areas may have been interrupted for up to 6 hours during the maintenance window. No further work is scheduled for this maintenance.
